description: Custom Carbon Fiber CNC Machining. We machine custom carbon fiber and composite parts to your exact specs, from one-off prototypes to full production runs, with CNC capabilities that handle stock up to 3" thick for precision-cut flat plate or complex geometries. Our work spans drone parts like frames, arms, and mounting plates built for strength-to-weight performance; custom boat parts including brackets, panels, and hardware engineered for marine environments; flat plate production in custom sizes and tolerances; and RC hobby parts such as chassis plates and mounts for RC cars, helicopters, and other builds. Whether you need a small prototype batch or a large-scale production run, we scale to fit your project. Send us your drawings or ideas, and we'll machine it right the first time.
